newsitem.title: USA: Intl Shipholding hurt by new vessel costs.
newsitem.headline: Intl Shipholding hurt by new vessel costs.

text.p: International Shipholding Corp said Thursday its first-quarter results were hurt by costs associated with adding a third vessel to its transatlantic line.
Chairman Niels Johnsen told Reuters the new vessel did not fill up with cargo to the extent expected, and this hurt first quarter numbers.
"She had to sail with space open...because of the open space and the vessel not filling, we didn't get the extra revenues," he said.
The company today reported lower first quarter earnings.
Johnsen said he expected improvements to begin in the second quarter.
